mentions.name: Tiny no-data-collection smartphone apps
mentions.description: This is a set of tiny, basic smartphone apps built by the author that collect no data of any kind and are designed for the author's own everyday use.
mentions.problem: Smartphone apps that don't collect any data are hard to find.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've slowly been making some tiny apps that just don't collect data in anyway that I want to use myself, pretty basic stuff.

evidence.value: I've slowly been making some tiny apps that just don't collect data in anyway that I want to use myself, pretty basic stuff.
